mapper.sql: w.*, l.name AS loraName, p.name AS presetName, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_item i WHERE i.workspace_id = w.id), 0) AS itemCount
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workspace w LEFT JOIN lora l ON l.id = w.lora_id LEFT JOIN preset p ON p.id = w.preset_id ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC, w.id DESC
SELECT FROM workspace w LEFT JOIN lora l ON l.id = w.lora_id LEFT JOIN preset p ON p.id = w.preset_id WHERE w.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace (name, lora_id, preset_id, note) VALUES (#{name}, #{loraId}, #{presetId}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace SET name = #{name}, lora_id = #{loraId}, preset_id = #{presetId}, note = #{note}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
